name: Villarquemado (Spain)
description: Blue field with the four red bars of Aragon in a hoist stripe with a pointed edge, charged with three yellow towers arranged two and one.
history: Municipal flag of Villarquemado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe with a pointed edge along the hoist bearing the red bars of Aragon
three towers arranged two and one
